name: ORB + Fibonacci Continuation (9:30-9:45 ORB, 5m execution)
description: Simplified, executable proxy of Owen's discretionary ORB + Fibonacci continuation setup: requires a confirmed break of the opening range, then waits for price to pull back into the classic 38.2%-61.8% retracement zone of the recent impulse before entering -- the same 'wait for the outburst, then enter on the retracement' idea described in the guide, expressed as bar-by-bar conditions instead of manually drawn swing points. This encodes the CONTINUATION setup only; the REVERSAL setup (redrawing a new Fibonacci from a structure-shift swing after the first breakout fails) is a multi-stage, path-dependent state machine this single-condition-tree schema can't express -- a Python strategy (arbitrary generate_signals(df) code) would be needed for that half. To test the 30-minute ORB instead, change session_end below from 09:45 to 10:00. The 12-bar fib lookback (~1 hour on the 5-minute chart) is a starting point, not a backtested-optimal value -- worth sweeping via Quick Optimize once run against real data.
